# Tuk Or Walk

> Tuk Or Walk is a one-person, sponsor-free budget travel site. It publishes free solo walking guides and event guides for Asia (Thailand live; Sri Lanka, Laos and India being written) with real prices in local currency, real walking times, toilets, water, food nearby and honest notes. All routes are walked first-hand and all photos are original.

## Trips (newest first)
- [Ayutthaya Food Festival](https://tukorwalk.com/trips/thailand/ayutthaya/ayutthaya-light-and-sound-show/food-festival/): A free night food festival beside the Wat Phra Ram ruins: cheap Thai street food, vendors in Thai dress, live music and bamboo tables. November 2026.
- [Ayutthaya Light and Sound Show](https://tukorwalk.com/trips/thailand/ayutthaya/ayutthaya-light-and-sound-show/): A free Queen Suriyothai drama with war elephants, Khon dance and fireworks at Wat Phra Ram, Ayutthaya. Seating tips, timings and the food festival next door. November 2026.
- [Vijit Chao Phraya 2026](https://tukorwalk.com/trips/thailand/bangkok/vijit-chao-phraya-2026/): A Bangkok riverside festival guide featuring the free Wat Arun drone show, fireworks near Memorial Bridge, MRT directions, viewing spots and Thai costume prices. 13 Nov–13 Dec 2026.
- [Khao San Halloween 2026](https://tukorwalk.com/trips/thailand/bangkok/khao-san-halloween-2026/): Halloween 2026 on Khao San Road, Bangkok: the free parade, costumes, club costume show, street food prices and MRT route, for about 400฿ a night.
- [Sathon temples walk](https://tukorwalk.com/trips/thailand/bangkok/sathon-temples-walk/): A free half-day walk in Bangkok: a Thai temple, three Chinese shrines, a cemetery park, 40฿ duck noodles and a 500฿ room. About 700฿ in total.

## Photo galleries
- [Ayutthaya Light and Sound Show gallery](https://tukorwalk.com/gallery/thailand/ayutthaya/ayutthaya-light-and-sound-show/): War elephants, Queen Suriyothai processions, battle scenes, Khon dance, fireworks and the food festival at Wat Phra Ram: free to watch, easy to photograph.
- [Vijit Chao Phraya 2026 gallery](https://tukorwalk.com/gallery/thailand/bangkok/vijit-chao-phraya-2026/): The Wat Arun drone show, laser shows and fireworks over the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok: 50 original photos, free to view.
- [Khao San Halloween 2026 gallery](https://tukorwalk.com/gallery/thailand/bangkok/khao-san-road/halloween-2026/): The Halloween parade and street costumes on Khao San Road, Bangkok: gold Thai dancers, Catwoman, creepy masks and more. Free to watch.
- [Bangkok temples & shrines gallery](https://tukorwalk.com/gallery/thailand/bangkok/sathon/): Golden-pillared Chinese shrines, quiet Thai temples, lantern-lit corridors and a hidden park with an arch bridge: free to enter, an easy walk apart and full of photo spots.

## Citing this site
Please credit "Tuk Or Walk (tukorwalk.com)" and link to the specific page. Prices are what the author paid on the date shown on each page.
